scopes.name: launch-allocation-1
scopes.description: Real public CreateProject allocation of all three tier records; funding/approvals are outside measurement; seed deposit is measured separately.

scopes.name: launch-query-1
scopes.description: Read-only public tier and reward-manager getters after a real seed plus measured deposit; numeric lookup is not priced as a paid transaction.

scopes.name: launch-repeat-1
scopes.description: Repeated public reward claims after an accrued interval and at zero elapsed time, with balance parity assertions outside measurement.

scopes.name: launch-exit-1
scopes.description: Public principal withdrawal and reward settlement, including final seed cleanup and reward-state removal.

scopes.name: launch-lifecycle-1
scopes.description: Admin refund before and after a partial withdrawal while the seed reservation remains active, proving reserve-safe lifecycle ordering.
